changelog:
Cisco Firewall Hardening Tool v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Cisco Firewall Hardening Tool.
- Automates CIS-compliant configuration generation for Cisco ASA and FTD firewalls.
- Supports flexible, customizable hardening options and rules.
- Provides endpoints for generating configurations, testing connectivity, and retrieving available hardening options.
- Returns comprehensive configuration details, compliance level, and applied rules.
- Includes free and paid pricing tiers for various usage needs.
summary: Generate CIS-compliant hardened Cisco ASA/FTD firewall configurations with customizable security options to enforce best practices and reduce manual errors.
